note: Marker that flags this as a T4 repo — the hooks fire only when this file is present, so they never touch a non-T4 repo. "verify" is the FAST ship gate (lint + typecheck + unit + build); t4-gate RUNS it before `gh pr merge` and blocks on failure. It points at scripts/verify.sh rather than `bun run verify` because the gate inherits the agent process's PATH, which on this machine has no bun — the script resolves bun from PATH or $HOME/.bun/bin. Keep it in sync with .github/workflows/t4-verify.yml; e2e belongs in CI, never here. "requireGreenCI" stays false because this repo is public and uses a branch ruleset with required checks, which is the stronger guarantee. Set "autoMerge" (or "afk") true during an unattended run so `gh pr merge` doesn't stop to ask for review confirmation — the verify and CI denies still apply. "afk": true additionally lets the gate permit `git reset --hard`/`git clean` for reverting a parked item to green (force-push and `branch -D` stay blocked).
